'''Kenny Easwaran''' is an Indian American philosopher and Associate Professor of Philosophy at the [[University of California, Irvine]].

His expertise lies in [[epistemology]], [[decision theory]], [[mathematical logic]] and [[philosophy of mathematics]].{{citation needed|date=September 2021}} Easwaran is an associate editor of ''[[Journal of Philosophical Logic]]''. Two of his articles have been selected as among the "ten best" of their year by the ''[[Philosopher's Annual]]''.<ref>{{cite web|title=The Philosopher's Annual|url=http://www.pgrim.org/philosophersannual/past.html#v34|website=www.pgrim.org|accessdate=25 March 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=The Philosopher's Annual|url=http://www.pgrim.org/philosophersannual/past.html#v35|website=www.pgrim.org|accessdate=25 March 2018}}</ref>
